translator.evidence: Original zh-HK (Hong Kong Traditional Chinese) difference catalog: 21 regional overrides drafted over Traditional Chinese for Taiwan (zh-TW) for Hong Kong terminology (用戶, 智能體, 互聯網, 項目, 點擊, 發送, 相片). Every other message resolves through the declared parent. Overrides keep the DEFAULT_STRINGS key order, exact placeholders, plural categories and ICU syntax. No upstream translated text was copied. This is AI-assisted project localization; no human or native-speaker translator claim is made.

reviewer.evidence: AI-assisted review of the zh-HK (Hong Kong Traditional Chinese) regional overrides checked each override for meaning, regional register, terminology consistency with the parent catalog, placeholder preservation and plural forms, and confirmed that no override merely repeats its parent value. Inherited messages were not re-reviewed beyond the parent catalog's own record. No human, native-speaker or independent human review is claimed.
